messages:
deploy-bot: Kicking off config-only deploy in change window 09:00-09:45 UTC. Changes: tenant default rate_limit 600->400 rps, request timeout 20000ms->13000ms, routing policy add 'latency-priority' for ap-southeast, batching.max_batch_size 64->32, prefix_kv_ttl 900s->450s. Canary: 2% for 8m -> 20% for 12m -> 80% for 10m -> 100%. Rollback guards: 5xx >0.4% OR p95 increase >1.5s OR gpu_util >85% sustained 5m.

deploy-bot: Release docs: https://internal.redwood/release/2026-03-config-1742601111

sam: ack. I'll watch traces and top endpoints. Note: lowering batch size could impact throughput on long-tail requests.

rebecca: I'm pinning canary to serving:stable-2026-03 to avoid any routing surprises. Also exclude analytics-heavy tenants: big-exports, report-generator.

noah: ops - add exclusion list and set up short-circuit rollback playbook. We should also pre-seed kvcache on new nodes to reduce eviction churn.

ops: exclusions set: ["big-exports","report-generator"]. Playbook link: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/config-rollback-quick

sre-oncall: Please enable high-res metrics for canary: 10s buckets on p95/p99, 1m for 5xx. Add alerts: p95 >1s (warn), p95 >1.5s (critical), 5xx >0.2% (warn), 5xx >0.4% (critical). Increase trace sampling for canary.

sam: adding dashboards. Also will track per-tenant 95th to ensure exclusions are honored.

deploy-bot: Applying 2% canary now.

deploy-bot: Canary 2% active.

sam: 2m in: p95 ~360ms, 5xx 0.01%, kvcache_evictions +1% — looks fine.

rebecca: model pin confirmed: serving:stable-2026-03 pinned for canary route.

sre-oncall: observed slight increase in inference-node cpu on shard-7 (+6%). No alerts.

deploy-bot: 2% window complete. Metrics nominal. Promoting to 20% for 12m.

deploy-bot: 20% active.

sam: at 20% after 4m: p95 480ms, 5xx 0.02%, kvcache_evictions +9%. Keep an eye on high-rpm endpoints /v1/chat/stream.

noah: pre-seed job kicked off on new shards; should reduce eviction churn in next 10m.

sre-oncall: eviction +9% noted. Not yet near rollback. Warning alert configured at +12%.

deploy-bot: Hold for 8m then continue. Canary automation will pause if any criticals fire.

rebecca: if eviction stays elevated but stable, we can proceed. But prepare to roll default TTL to 600s in follow-up patch.

ops: filed ticket INF-512: 'kv-ttl-eval-and-warmup' and assigned to infra.

deploy-bot: 20% window complete. Metrics: p95 delta +60ms, 5xx delta +0.01%, evictions +11%. All within thresholds. Proceeding to 80% for 10m.

deploy-bot: 80% active.

sam: immediate spike on ramp: p95 -> 1.2s for 90s then stabilized at 620ms. No 5xx spike.

sre-oncall: saw short-lived GPU util bump on two pods hitting 82% during ramp. No sustained breach.

rebecca: hold a micro-window at 80% for 6 more minutes to validate stability.

deploy-bot: Holding at 80% per request.

sre-oncall: after hold, p95 back to 600ms, 5xx steady, gpu util back to 60-70%. Good to continue.

deploy-bot: Rolling to 100% now. Change window still open until 09:45 UTC.

deploy-bot: Rollout complete: 100%.

sam: post-roll (5m): p95 630ms, 5xx 0.03%, kvcache_evictions +12%, GPU util nominal. No rollback triggers met.

noah: follow-up: recommend default TTL to 600s and implement node warmup prefetch. I'll update INF-512 with data.

rebecca: leaving canary pin for one more day on serving:stable-2026-03; we'll unpin after config settles.

ops: release notes updated and linked: https://internal.redwood/release/2026-03-config-1742601111#summary. INF-512 added.

sre-oncall: monitoring for 1h post-window then will downgrade alerting. No current handoffs.

sam: thanks all. If anyone sees regressions ping #eng-oncall and run the playbook.
